title: Keep the catalog usable during a Shipping outage
scenario: The shared Shipping service is unreachable. All three inventory services still answer, but the delivery preview requires a quote for each product.
why: Customers can still browse products and check stock during a carrier outage. Showing an unavailable estimate avoids promising a price or delivery date.
reproduce: Disconnect Shipping in Network Faults. Compare “Refresh all availability” and “Preview all deliveries”.
ready: Clear all faults and restore default settings. Start the stack with the launcher. Keep background traffic unchanged; compare fresh 60–90-second windows and changes in rejected requests. Use Storefront for customer results and Grafana for workers, queue, rejections and dependency circuits.
assignment: Can customers see live stock for every product while every delivery estimate is unavailable?

tasks.title: Compare both healthy catalog views
tasks.instruction: Refresh availability and preview deliveries. Record all products, timings and queue state. Set an abort condition and predict which view Shipping affects.

tasks.title: Disconnect shared Shipping
tasks.instruction: Disconnect Shipping and repeat both views. Record catalog failure, working availability and Shipping errors. Check whether the queue actually fills.

tasks.title: Identify the coupling
tasks.instruction: Check Shipping failures and queue size in Grafana. Compare stock-only results with delivery previews for the lamp, chair and desk.

tasks.title: Enable fallback during the outage
tasks.instruction: Leave Shipping disconnected and apply Challenge 2 settings. Preview all deliveries again. Record the stock and quote status for each product and watch fallback activity.

tasks.title: Reconnect and verify recovery
tasks.instruction: Reconnect Shipping with fallback still enabled. After the five-second cooldown, refresh to allow a recovery probe. Refresh again and verify three live quotes. Restore default settings and submit your observations.

done: You observed working availability and failed delivery previews during a shared outage.
With the outage still active, all three products showed live stock and unavailable quotes.
After reconnecting Shipping, you verified live quotes and restored defaults.
solution: Stock checks use the category inventory services. Delivery previews also need shared Shipping.
With fallback off, the unavailable quotes cause the delivery request to fail. With fallback on, all three stocks remain visible and all three quotes are marked unavailable.
The shared breaker pauses repeated Shipping calls for five seconds before allowing one probe. A fast disconnect can leave the worker queue empty.
Reconnecting restores the network path. A successful probe allows live quotes on subsequent previews.

fields.label: Healthy baseline and metric
fields.prompt: Record your baseline. Include all the data you identify as relevant from Grafana into your notes. Watch healthy availability and delivery carefully.

fields.label: Hypothesis, blast radius, and abort condition
fields.prompt: What could be the impact of an unavailable shipping service? Which functions will fail?

fields.label: Outage evidence
fields.prompt: Disconnect shared Shipping. Compare availability and delivery for all products. Record catalog status, queue size and new rejections.

fields.label: Mitigation and reason
fields.prompt: Why allow an unavailable quote? Explain timeout, breaker and fallback separately.

fields.label: Same-outage validation
fields.prompt: Record results under the same outage. Include all products and catalog time/status; record queue size and new rejections from Grafana over the same window.

fields.label: Blast-radius conclusion and cleanup
fields.prompt: Did the impact shrink? What is still missing? Confirm cleanup.

mitigationHelp.description: Shipping fallback returns an unavailable quote. The shared breaker limits repeated calls during the outage.
mitigationHelp.instruction: Apply Challenge 2 settings while Shipping is disconnected.
